description: Connect ChatGPT or Codex to a curated, read-only ClassWise academic overview using an active school or district staff-member or administrator account. ClassWise can identify authorized organizations, list permitted district descendants, show academic terms and course-catalog entries, list classes with bounded basic day/time/room meetings, show class subjects, and return subject and bell-period schedule details only when the current role has schedule-management or gradebook permission. It returns one school-wide active-enrollment count per school, with counts below 10 suppressed. A school user remains limited to current active staff-member or administrator access for that school. A district user retains only the descendant-school scope already granted by an eligible ClassWise role. ClassWise rechecks current eligibility and permissions for every organization-specific request. The public connector cannot change ClassWise data and does not expose student-level records, per-class enrollment counts, enrollment cells by program, grade, or status, grades, attendance, health or medical information, disability or accommodation records, individual-service plans, discipline records, government-issued identifiers, finance or payment records, message content, credentials, authentication or role administration, raw SQL, arbitrary URLs, or platform controls. Separately contracted private administrator integrations are outside this listing.

defaultPrompt: Show the ClassWise schools and districts this account can access. Summarize the scope without exposing internal database IDs.
Show the academic terms and course catalog for Pine Valley High School.
Compare enrollment across Pine Valley schools. Cite each school, preserve suppressed values, and never infer missing data.
